name: Sawai Riko
source:
Another member of the Cyber Force Dolls; on stage, she stands left of Bambi. 19 years old.

Riko is a police officer from the TMPD Cyber Security Control Division; she just happened to be forced to audition for the Cyber Force Dolls, too. Despite her lack of interest in the position, she was chosen for it.

She may not be eager to do the work, but to her, that’s no reason to slack off; she always takes her job seriously.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
